summary: ARMOUR Residential REIT filed an Item 8.01/9.01 Form 8-K announcing a routine monthly common dividend of $0.24 per share for November 2026, with record date November 16, 2026 and payment date November 27, 2026. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, notes REIT distribution requirements and that dividends are declared at board discretion. No structural, transactional, or ownership changes are disclosed. The filing is an ordinary dividend declaration rather than a special situation; the risk-arb angle is not applicable, with focus limited to ex-date mechanics and monthly rate stability.
